verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's evidence shows integration with Jira issues (viewing/managing Jira issues via a built-in Jira UI and automatic status updates from commits) but no native Bitbucket board or roadmap feature — planning capability is offloaded to Jira rather than built into Bitbucket itself. Missing for 10: no mention of Bitbucket-native kanban/scrum boards, roadmap views, backlog grooming, or epic/story hierarchy management within Bitbucket; only cross-linking to Jira issues is documented.
